decision_summary.inspector_model: Read-only, contextual; actions navigate to existing owning tools.
decision_summary.inspector_purpose: Inspect one map-linked spatial/result entity without replacing the active task drawer.
decision_summary.pareto_solution: Keep in Results master/detail; do not put in inspector.
decision_summary.state_owner: App-level local React orchestration using a small typed entity reference; no new global state system.
decision_summary.map_inspect_select: Introduce a minimal explicit Inspect / Select-cells boundary in the 8E cell pilot; armed map-edit modes take priority.
decision_summary.scenario_workspace: Move to dedicated Plan > Scenarios tool.
decision_summary.rf_diagnostics_ia: Keep one Analyze tool; canonical actions plus Research internal subviews Validation / Materials / Reflection, one visible at a time.
decision_summary.results: Compact source-aware summary and progressive objective/configuration/explanation detail.
decision_summary.run_history: Retain in Review; in-tool list/detail with Back, never global inspector.
decision_summary.data: Compact planning summary, Data/Model/Provenance details; developer commands tucked away; keep measurement calibration evidence workflow explicit.
decision_summary.optimization_priorities: Compact, scannable objective rows with visible meaning, direction, value and slider.
decision_summary.draft_guard: Preserve destructive Scenario-switch protection; fix same-Scenario false trigger and improve recovery affordance; no unsupported Discard action.
decision_summary.stale_results: Preserve freshness semantics and exact source identity; edits stay stale until current run; no silent recompute.
decision_summary.8e_scope: Inspector foundation and current map inspector relocation, with designed Cell, Building and Interference sample families; preserve/reuse existing read-only feature renderers for other current map selections.
decision_summary.8c_timing: Wait until 8D decisions and the 8E pilot interaction contract are accepted; use pilot evidence to scope the broader map-toolbar regrouping.
decision_summary.data_measurements: Keep Data CSV residual/global-bias calibration separate from RF Diagnostics campaign validation. Data calibration may explicitly apply an eligible correction to the plan; RF Diagnostics Validation is an evidence ledger and does not promote or mutate a canonical model.

per_viewport.1440: Right inspector overlays opposite map edge; left task remains open; about 672px clear map corridor.
per_viewport.1280: Inspector replaces/hides task drawer in one panel slot; back restores task; about 872px map region.
per_viewport.1024: One inspector panel; about 616px map region.
per_viewport.768: One full-width bottom sheet at a time; target max around 55vh.
per_viewport.390: One full-width sheet at a time; visible map strip, scrollable inspector, bottom stage rail.

scenario_and_stale_findings.same_scenario_guard: Potential bug: openSavedScenario blocks whenever a draft exists and activeScenarioId is null, without checking whether the clicked Scenario is already the current draft source. ScenarioPanel leaves the current row clickable. openScenarioRevision does guard same-current differently.
scenario_and_stale_findings.cross_scenario_guard: Semantically valid for a destructive switch: the draft remains locally preserved and the user is told to save it as a Version first.
scenario_and_stale_findings.discard: No discardDraft/clearDraft domain operation was found; do not offer Discard changes.
scenario_and_stale_findings.recovery: Show the destination Scenario and draft being protected. Offer Save Version and Stay; after save, require an explicit Open destination action. Preserve the local draft and explain how to return.
scenario_and_stale_findings.stale: RF-affecting edit invalidates rendered results and sets planDirty. Returning controls to a matching-looking value does not clear planDirty; current policy stays stale until a successful new Run/restore. Keep exact Run/source identity visible.

concept8e_reason: The existing App already has a local selectedMapObject and read-only MapInspector renderers. The high-value gap is placement/lifecycle, not a new entity framework. A cohesive conversion of existing map inspector content plus three representative spatial families exercises the shell, source/freshness and data-loading contracts while keeping Pareto, Run and Report as their existing owned workflows.
evidence_limits: Concept 8B.1 screenshots cover shell/drawer geometry and selected result views, not a paired inspector or all listed tools.
Base map tiles failed in supplied captures; map extent judgments remain qualitative and require live map verification during 8E.
